sentences.text: By this application under Section 438 CrPC, the petitioner, namely, Dulal Ali apprehending his arrest is seeking pre arrest bail in Bijni P.S. Case No.51/2023 registered under Sections 420/489(C)/34 IPC.
Matter relates to involvement of distribution of fake currency.
Perused the case diary placed before the Court today by Mr. Goswami, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.
Case diary reveals sufficient incriminating materials regarding involvement of the petitioner in supplying of the fake currency.
The petitioner is evading arrest and the investigation is still on.

The petitioner claimed that the other two arrested accused in said Bijni P.S. Case No.51/2023,
Lalrinsanga and Sahabuddin have already been released on bail by coordinate Benches of this Court.

Finding sufficient incriminating materials in the case diary against the petitioner regarding his involvement in the alleged crime of supplying counterfeit currency, the Court is of the view that it is not a fit case to grant pre-arrest bail to the petitioner, namely, Dulal Ali in said Bijni P.S. Case No.51/2023.
Accordingly, this pre-arrest bail application of the petitioner, Dulal Ali in said Bijni P.S. Case No.51/2023 stands rejected.
